recognizer_model: Default unrestricted English acoustic model, CMU dictionary and language model from official installed PocketSphinx wheel.
method: Decode actual completed AAC to stereo48k floatPCM; use the same five frozen mixed-speech windows with100ms lead and 150ms tail; average channels; resample to16k; recognize without expected text, prompt, grammar or new dictionary; score the returned transcript afterward.
normalization: Lowercase, remove punctuation, tokenize apostrophe words; OpenLine normalized as open line for scoring only, not supplied to the recognizer.
